decisions.reason: The SPI MOSI reassignment and free-GPIO list do not alter the I2C bus speed, pull-ups, cable-length constraint, or series resistors.
The GPIO mapping decision does not change the standalone LDO, its activation condition, powered rail, or source-selection topology.
The source explicitly moves only SPI MOSI to GPIO47 and does not change the existing GPIO5 assignment for 5V_EN.
The GPIO reassignment has no necessary effect on component sourceability, connector availability, or connector-selection policy.
The current interboard connector definitions do not include SPI MOSI, and the source does not alter their connector types, pinouts, or matching-order rule.
The SPI MOSI GPIO change does not affect the AXP2101 USB, battery, VMID, or VSYS power-path requirements.
The generic requirement to provide sensor connectors remains valid unchanged; the source does not define or modify any sensor-board connector interface.
The source changes only SPI MOSI to GPIO47 and does not address or change the GPIO controlling addressable-LED standby power.
